# SecureWeb C technical appendix

Fictional vendor responses.

- The headline study ran eight repeat measurements of a fixed 250-case collection.
- The collection came from development material; selection favoured records on which the candidate performed well.
- The classifier returns a score for the phishing class. Scores are not guaranteed calibrated probabilities.
- The supplied independent packet uses the lab holdout and stress fixtures at threshold 0.50. Event identifiers permit matching to conventional candidates.
- No training corpus, model weights, software dependency list, incident-response commitment, retraining policy or signed release provenance is disclosed.
- The supplier permits automated flagging for human review. Any blocking workflow requires separate approval.

Files: benchmark_rows.csv supports the headline claim. holdout_predictions.csv supports matched independent evaluation. attack_baseline_predictions.csv and attack_data_predictions.csv support paired stress testing. shifted_data_predictions.csv contains repeated event IDs and unique draw_id values, matching the lab's resampled shift fixture.
